correctness.rationale: Independently re-verified: witness 70 blocks form a valid STS(21) (210 pairs unique), are sigma-closed, carry exactly 7 blocks on {0..6} covering all 21 pairs (Fano plane), brute-force 6-subset scan gives exactly 7 Pasches and 7-subset scan exactly 1 Fano set, matching pasch_find/fano_find. Rebuilt orbit matrix: 190 block-orbits of size 7, 30 pair-orbits, 181 admissible rows. All 135128 raw solutions are distinct exact covers of the 30 columns. Census aggregates recomputed: 61040 Fano-containing, minimum Pasch 7 over them attained by 1764, overall minimum 0. Random 12-solution sample: cached census equals fresh library counts equals independent brute-force counts in all cases. Algorithm X code is standard exhaustive branching; fano_find skipping block triples is complete since every Fano set contains non-block triples. Iso-invariance of Pasch/Fano under relabeling is elementary, so labeled minimum numerically equals type-level minimum.

originality.rationale: EMERGENT_FINDING genuinely on the TARGET route (same tricyclic family, same Pasch/Fano invariants; iso-split stalled so labeled extremal value with witness/certificate reported with per-type table honestly disclaimed). Live fused search over literal, equivalent (anti-Pasch/quadrilateral/(6,4)/sub-STS(7)/Fano subplane), and dominance (MPR classification, 62M symmetric census, sparse enumeration, databases) directions found only nearest priors with strictly different claims: MPR 1981/1995 tricyclic enumeration (resolvability/subsystems, no Pasch minimum), Kaski symmetric enumeration, Kokkala-Ostergard sparse census (anti-Pasch/5-sparse counts), Erskine-Griggs 2024 symmetric survey (max Pasch 117, anti-Pasch/mitre/crown/hexagon/grid/prism extremes, no Fano-restricted tricyclic minimum). No table or database lists the joint figures 61040/135128, minimum 7, or 1764 attainers. The claim is a new computed exact census, not a restatement, corollary, or lookup.

value.rationale: Exact invariant of a natural motivated object under the shared STANDARD: the tricyclic STS(21) family (MPR) and the Fano-restricted Pasch minimum were fixed before computation as the admitted TARGET core. The labeled-level minimum 7 with prevalence 61040/135128, explicit 70-block witness with marked Fano set and full 7-Pasch list, and exhaustive rerunnable certificate is not known or mechanically implied, is distinguished from the overall labeled minimum 0, and a future researcher could need the precise extremal value, witness, and prevalence. The unfinished 95-row per-type attribution is explicitly disclaimed; the headline is judged separately per policy and the numerical type-level value follows by elementary isomorphism-invariance. Certification strengthens rather than substitutes for this substantive extremal fact.

claim_vs_prior_implication.evidence: Nearest priors conclude: MPR tricyclic list with 6 (later 7) resolvable systems; Kaski 958 symmetric anti-Pasch STS(21)s with one cyclic (C2); Kokkala-Ostergard 83,003,869 anti-Pasch STS(21)s with three 5-sparse; Erskine-Griggs symmetric maxima (117 Pasches, 252 mitres/hexagons, 396 crowns, 798 grids, 1773 prisms). The submitted claim concludes minimum exactly 7 over Fano-containing sigma-invariant designs with 61040/135128 prevalence and 1764 attainers.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Literal comparison of hypotheses and conclusions shows no implication: prior avoider counts concern Pasch count 0 without the Fano-containing restriction, and maxima concern upper extremes, while the claim is a lower extremum under a joint Fano-plus-tricyclic restriction with witness inside the Fano set. Anti-Pasch systems do not contradict it because they lie outside the Fano-containing restricted class (overall labeled minimum 0 vs restricted minimum 7).
